```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Commitment to honor the commitment to 25 million veterans in the United States.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"America is dedicated to honoring its commitment to veterans.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Veterans have helped shape the American character.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Veterans' service represents the highest form of national service.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Bush and Congress have increased funding for veterans services, including substantial increases in Veterans' Administration (VA) health care funding.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Increased funding has made it possible for the VA to improve health care access for veterans who need it most, including low-income veterans, those with service-connected disabilities, and those who need VA's specialized services.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Bush has twice signed legislation effectively providing \"concurrent receipt\" of both military retiree pay and VA disability compensation for combat-injured and highly-disabled veterans, thus reversing a century-old law preventing concurrent receipts.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Bush has fulfilled his promise to cut the disability claims backlog that existed when he took office and reduce waiting times for veterans seeking initial medical care.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for more care to more veterans in more places where they need it most.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Appreciation for the President's efforts to maintain and expand national cemeteries.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"With World War II veterans dying at the rate of 4,000 a day, the opening of the nation's World War II Memorial in Washington, D.C. is noted with great appreciation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
